description: Report that the archive is uploaded and start the analysis. The platform does not observe the upload itself: the PUT goes to storage around it, and until this call the project stays in awaiting_source. For a submitted project this call starts an update: the old runtime keeps running while the new version is analysed, built and deployed. blob_key comes from create_project or get_upload_url.
name: complete_upload
title: Finish the upload and analyse
